newsitem.title: FRANCE: Five ships loading wheat in Rouen, three more due.
newsitem.headline: Five ships loading wheat in Rouen, three more due.

text.p: Five ships are loading a total of 102,000 tonnes of wheat at Rouen, port officials said on Monday.
The wheat is for export to South Africa, Algeria, Cuba, Italy, and Turkey, they said.
One ship is also loading 26,000 tonnes of barley destined for Saudi Arabia.
Three more ships are expected in port very shortly to load around 42,000 tonnes of wheat. The destination was not specified.
